title: FBI-UAP-D038, Digital Rendering 1, “Multiple Red Lights,” 2026
doc_notes: This document is a digital rendering created by the FBI in 2026 as a visual aid for the PURSUE initiative, based on a first-hand description of a 2026 UAP sighting.

incidents.summary: Two glowing red, horizontal, disc-shaped or cigar-shaped objects observed hovering above mountain peaks in the western United States.
incidents.quote: Hovering in the sky above the mountain peaks are two distinct, glowing red, horizontal, disc-shaped or cigar-shaped objects.
